claim_translation_en: A flash-flood event affected rural Salmas County on 22 October 2026
analyst_interpretation: Multiple mutually consistent reports establish event occurrence but not mapped extent
claim_boundary: Source-reported fact rather than independent spatial observation

claim_translation_en: Initial operational reporting named Kaniyan Shurik Silab Mafi Kandi and Shekeryazi
analyst_interpretation: The five-place scope is an early report and conflicts with a later four-village aggregate
claim_boundary: Later reports used a different village count; preserve versions

claim_translation_en: Two deaths six injured and two missing
analyst_interpretation: This is a time-stamped operational report and not a final casualty census
claim_boundary: Counts may be superseded and are not a privacy-safe person register

claim_translation_en: A later official report recorded three deaths and 120 affected dwellings across four villages
analyst_interpretation: The dwelling definition and settlement allocation are unavailable
claim_boundary: Not observed building damage and not allocable to footprints

claim_original_fa: بیشترین خسارت در روستای کانیان شهرستان سلماس بوده است
claim_translation_en: The greatest damage was in Kaniyan village in Salmas County
analyst_interpretation: Quoted operational characterization lacks a defined severity metric
claim_boundary: Reported assessment not an independent measurement

claim_translation_en: The maximum flood extent is currently unknown
analyst_interpretation: No authoritative polygon complete survey or valid satellite pair has been identified
claim_boundary: Absence of a mapped extent is not evidence of no flooding

claim_translation_en: The event was caused by a quantified rainfall intensity at village scale
analyst_interpretation: No verified gauge or pluviograph observation has been acquired
claim_boundary: IMERG regional support cannot establish village intensity

claim_translation_en: The event is attributable to climate change
analyst_interpretation: A single event reconstruction cannot establish attribution
